body.x: Snapkeys(www.snapkeys.com), the inventor of 2i technology, the revolutionary answer to the cumbersome 'Qwerty' keyboard for mobile devices, will be on hand at this year’s CES Trade show in Las Vegas Jan.10 -13. Snapkeys is promoting their keyless keyboard technology through a contest that seeks 1,000`s (The most number of people ever) to break the Guinness World Record for fastest typing speed. You can download the App in the coming weeks on the Android Market Place or Apple App Store – ‘World Record’.

Snapkeys devised its 'invisible interface' technology as a new digital keyboard for tablets and smartphones. In a desire to encourage more people to switch from the traditional 'Qwerty' keyboard they have built an app available for use at this year’s CES trade show.

The 'Qwerty' keyboard has been universally popular since 1878, but with newer information mediums becoming the norm throughout the world, the 'Qwerty keyboard has become cumbersome. Others have tried to improve the Qwerty, but Snapkeys 2i technology has more than a decade of R&D behind it, allowing for mobile technology to reach a new level of use through their invisible interface.

In adopting powerful smartphones, users have had to settle with using a tiny keyboard on a little screen only to compromise comfort for the sake of mobility. Why compromise on our comfort levels? Can’t we have it all?

The goal of Snapkeys is to provide a real solution to the 'Qwerty' keyboard problem, a chronic issue in the mobile industry. Snapkeys achieves a practical and high performance user experience, offering 99% accuracy and 100% comfort through its 4-shape invisible keys.
1. With only 4 invisible keys, users make less typing errors. Fewer keys allows for greater accuracy while typing.
2. With invisible keys, the user can now view the full content of the whole screen of their mobile device – enabling immediate access to more information, and an improved user experience.
3. The user’s ability to pick it up quickly and type from the start makes it an obvious winner.
These advantages make for a comfortable and practical data entry experience while on the move. Stay tuned for upcoming cooperation announcements during this exciting Consumer Electronics Show.

Snapkeys is a technology startup focusing on providing comfortable data entry solutions to enhance usability of touch-screen and computing devices, and search experience for media platforms. Snapkeys is privately held, with its sales office in New York and R&D located in Jerusalem, Israel.
